messages:
eli: Hey team, just got pinged by a customer (using node) — their calls to the TS SDK suddenly 404 when hitting a route that used to work. They said it started after yesterday's deploy.

jordan: Can you paste the request they run?

eli: Sure — from their repro: 
```js
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.requests.create({ model: 'ggml-13b', prompt: 'hello' });
```
They get 404 with body: `{ "error": "route_not_found", "path": "/v1/requests.create" }`

maya: Hmm that path looks wrong — our API uses RESTy paths like `/v1/requests` with POST, not RPC-style `requests.create`. Are they on an older SDK that used RPC mapping?

eli: They sent their package.json: `"redwood-sdk": "^0.7.2"` and said they pinned to 0.7 because of another breaking change. Our latest hosted change introduced a route rename (we switched to explicit verbs in 1.2.0).

jordan: Ah — so older TS client maps `client.requests.create()` to `/v1/requests.create` whereas server now expects `POST /v1/requests`. Should be a compatibility layer on the server, but looks like it was removed in the deploy.

ops-luis: release-bot showed the deploy yesterday 2026-03-15 03:12 UTC — `remove-legacy-rpc-route-adapter` landed in service/main. I tagged it to cleanup tech debt.

maya: @jordan can we do a short-term fallback? Either re-add adapter or add 301 redirect mapping for `*/requests.create` -> `/v1/requests`? Customers on old SDKs will be hit.

jordan: Agree. For immediate mitigation we can add nginx mapping for the RPC-style endpoints to the new paths. I'll open a quick PR to the infra repo with regex rewrites and roll it as a hotfix.

eli: Meanwhile can we give the customer repro steps and a temporary workaround? They can call the REST endpoint directly: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/requests \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"ggml-13b","prompt":"hello"}'
```
This works for them.

jordan: Also I'll update SDK release notes to flag the mapping change. But ideally we shouldn't break existing published SDKs without a deprecation window. We need a follow-up postmortem.

ops-luis: Hotfix PR opened: infra/redirects#432 — rewrites for `^/v1/(.+)\.([a-z]+)$` -> `/v1/$1` with method mapping for `.create` -> POST, `.list` -> GET, etc. Rolling to canary now.

release-bot: Deploy started for infra/redirects#432 (canary) — sha ab12cd3.

maya: Great. For support reply draft: explain root cause (server removed legacy RPC adapter), provide curl workaround and suggest upgrading to `redwood-sdk@^1.0.0` which uses RESTy paths. Add note: if they can't upgrade, we have a temporary redirect in place.

eli: I'll send that to the customer. One more thing — they also reported param name mismatch: older SDK uses `model` but server now accepts `model_name`. Did the hotfix handle param aliasing?

jordan: The redirect only rewrites path + verb. We need to add a small body transform middleware to accept `model` -> `model_name` for compatibility. I'll add that to the hotfix as a second commit.

ops-luis: Canary showing 200s for the redirected calls now. Adding middleware patch next.

eli: Thanks. I'll follow up after release.

(30m later)

release-bot: infra/redirects#432 rolled to prod — sha ab12cd3 + ab12ff0 (body-compat).

jordan: Patch deployed. We added request body aliasing for `model`, `prompt` -> `input.prompt`, and kept logs. Also emitting a compatibility warning header `X-RW-Compat: legacy-sdk` so we can track usage.

maya: Nice. Can we export metrics for legacy hits so eng/product can reach out to customers still on old SDKs?

jordan: Yes, statsd metric `compat.legacy_sdk_hits` incremented on those rewrites. Dashboards in console/observability prepped.

eli: Customer confirmed their app works now after the workaround. I'll close the ticket once we notify them about upgrade path.

maya: Follow-up tasks: 1) Postmortem on removal of adapter (assigned jordan), 2) Backfill policy for deprecations (maya), 3) Draft communication and migration guide (eli).

eli: Added tasks to support board and scheduled meeting with SDK owners. Closing thread after customer ack. :thumbsup:
